name: Lil
english_description: A fixed-up version of the MudOS driver testsuite lib with docs added, per its own lpmuds.net listing -- genuinely a from-scratch bootstrapping base, not a game: no accounts, no rooms, no combat, no Intermud. Connecting auto-assigns a name and drops straight into an anonymous, already-wizard session with about ten primitive commands, plus a sizeable bundled compiler/efun/operator self-test suite meant for driver developers. Only one real FluffOS-compat fix was needed: the mudlib's designated global-include stub shipped empty, but nearly the entire bundled self-test suite silently relied on it to supply its ASSERT()/SAVETP/RESTORETP macros, so 150 of 199 files failed to compile until it was wired up. One genuine driver-dialect gap was found and left as-is (not a mudlib bug): this driver's preprocessor doesn't implement C-style ## token pasting, which one compiler self-test specifically exercises. An `efun <name>` command referenced by both the boot banner and the mudlib's own README was never actually shipped in the archive -- documented, not invented.
